text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove suddenly stops in her tracks.
Her gaze is fixed on a crane game.
The prizes are... Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fool. It is not as if I want it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I received a gift from a junior.
I was just thinking about what might make a fitting return gift.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She is also someone striving toward her dreams through diligent training. She might just bring some much-needed solace to daily life.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, relying on a crane game prize lacks
certainty... I'll rule this one out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, bold words.
Intriguing... I shall hold you to them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let me witness with my own eyes the skill of the "Empress's" Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
